description: Read the live brand: version, facts, the business and design overviews (markdown), colors with roles (hex is authoritative), fonts, marks, personas, tagged context files, the Brand Studio imagery (the merchant's own photos, the first choice for page images), and the brand's imported Figma designs. Version 0 with empty fields means no brand yet. `extraction` is the latest website import: poll this with increasing delays until its importId matches the one update_brand returned and its status is completed or failed. Read-only. Read the brand's files by id with read_file; the paths are where Replo's agent reads them. Does not start an agent session.

projectId.description: The project whose saved brand to read.
